bridge.source: ICGC RTT173781 labels tpn as tauler de pont in primary layer metadata; measured quadrilateral and width4.664-4.912m. CAD17A461front registers portal. deckFit.method: Least-squares plane along the verified RTT bridge axis. Excludes near-facade DSM186.713roofcell. No use of MET5 or requested clearance to choose deck height.

bridge.oldAxisStatus: Initial ortho-estimated axis rejected after direct RTTdeck identified; all former air/terrain diagnoses refer to that obsolete axis and are not final-model limitations.

gate.source: Official guide current entrance photo and dimensions of neighbouring municipal casemate185.362; neoclassical portal proportions estimated. Door/tunnel through casemate is open, no invented sealed ramp.

registration.method: Ray from authoritative RTT173781axis against municipal17A461front. Frame inset0.1m into the roofed casemate. RTTquad includes the access deck; reserve an estimated3.8m inner deck length within total span, not beyond the footprint.

scope.included: Measured central ranges, main court/lightwell, watchtower and4sentries, municipal casemates/guard ranges, verified RTTmasonry walls of all4bastions, hornwork, ravelin, lunettes and retaining works, and4-arch entrance bridge.
scope.terrain: Earth-filled platforms, court floor, grass, glacis and moat bottom remain consumer MET5 terrain. The GLB comprises closed masonry solids only; separate terrain-supported shells are intentional and not joined by an invented base.
scope.roofHoles: Municipal core has6 holes:1869.878m2 court+60.373m2 lightwell; four~4m2 holes are occupied by separate measured taller sentry turrets. Watchtower hole is occupied by204.805m cap.
scope.omitted: Slender antenna/weather fixtures causing isolated DSM212.838m; flags, guns, planting, furniture, tiny decoration. OSM source fetch remains pending after prior429/406 and is not needed for the verified municipal/RTT identity.
scope.marineCorrection: Two selected existing OSM-derived vector masonry bands complete the missing sea-side support; no platform/soil fill. Circular corner projections are short cantilevered bodies, not pillars to the moat. No aggregate vector feature ID is marked for complete replacement.

uncertainties: Wall plan uses verified ICGC RTT masonry polygons, independently checked against current ortho and official site plan. Unroofed walls retain RTT relative height over sparse local low-side DTM; cap/base changes and hidden foundations remain approximate. Cells on vertical faces, vegetation and fixtures are ambiguous.

The official plan is a current explanatory diagram, not a surveyed elevation. Exact roofed caps use municipal CAD. Unroofed walls use RTT height plus local ground rather than a single global cap or floor.

Most retaining walls have no roofed municipal MESH and are independent bands with locally measured bases. The consumer must keep MET5 slopes and voids; this GLB alone intentionally has no land between masonry strips.
Portal proportions, wall recesses, bridge arch profile and parapet thickness are approximate visual interpretations. Recesses preserve recognizable large forms rather than fine masonry.

The two sea-wall bands have local reconstructed crown/base profiles from sparse DSM/DTM; vegetation/mixed face cells are rejected. Corner corbels are approximated from the official axonometry, without assuming four identical conical shelters. Coping levels of existing RTT walls are unchanged.
